userDirection: 用户圈出传送点之间的空档过大；本稿仅收紧右侧地点列表，维持其余视觉基线。

visualAlignment.shell: Original rounded double-gold frame and preparation surface/header textures; no new BG3 plaque/chrome.
visualAlignment.navigation: Pure text, 17px, 72x48 targets, 8px gap, state.selected text with original prep-active-v5 underline.

header.previewMode: Explicit left return on both pages, per current user instruction; same public back.svg / 20 glyph / 48 touch. No right close target.

visualAlignment.buttons: Existing prep-button-dark-v2 and prep-skill-selected-v5 original art; visible skin inside independent 48px targets.

taskPage.layout: Left hierarchical quest journal / right dark narrative text, independent scrolling. No parchment reading card.
taskPage.displayState: Illustrative post-survey state with both rescue options still open. Not the user save.

mapPage.layout: Legend on the left, large regional map in the center, separate waypoint list on the right. The task tree does not stay on this page.
mapPage.markerPositions: Schematic mockup positions for visual hierarchy, not runtime coordinates or fog-discovery evidence.
mapPage.travelState: Illustrative unlocked and safe travel state; real release must retain existing unlock, combat and landing checks.
mapPage.footerPosition: Immediately follows the content-height list, with an 8px gap; no stretched blank space.

stateScope: Quest, markers, map discovery and teleport availability are illustrative existing-content design states, not the player save or runtime acceptance.

compactness.touchTargets: Header, map tools and main actions retain 48px targets. Waypoint row visual pitch is 28px in this static candidate; per-row mobile touch and hit-area acceptance are pending.
compactness.separateControls: Navigation and primary-action spacing retained. No overlapping invisible 48px row targets were added.
compactness.changes: Waypoint list pitch 48 -> 28, active frame 26 -> 22, content-sized list and adjacent travel action.
